title: 基础模型代理的部署时记忆化研究
summary: 本文研究基础模型代理在部署时的记忆化问题，提出隐私-效用前沿，通过个性化召回和对抗提取率评估记忆设计选择（摘要攻击性、检索广度、删除模式），并引入遗忘残留分数衡量删除信息的可恢复性。实验表明关键事实摘要可大幅降低提取风险，但原始删除无法完全清除派生摘要副本。
summary_en: This paper studies deployment-time memorization in foundation-model agents, formulating a privacy-utility frontier measured by Personalization Recall and Adversarial Extraction Rate, and introducing the Forgetting Residue Score. Experiments show key-fact summarization reduces extraction risk but raw deletion leaves derived copies recoverable.
